title: Since / For
voiceover: Since ve For gördüğünde Present Perfect düşün. Have veya Has artı V3. Since başlangıç noktası verir. Since 2010, 2010'dan beri. For süre verir. For ten years, on yıldır. I have lived here since 2010. I have lived here for ten years. Daha fazlası sinyal-avcisi.com. Odaklan ve kazan.

slides.title: SINCE / FOR
slides.formula:
SINCE + başlangıç noktası
FOR + süre
→ HAVE / HAS + V3
slides.example:
I have lived here since 2010.
I have lived here for ten years.
slides.tip:
SINCE = başlangıç noktası (2010'dan beri)
FOR = süre (on yıldır)
